technology_name: TYRPHOSTIN AG 1478 AND KINETIN RIBOSIDE BASED COMPOSITION TO MIMIC THE EFFECTS OF CALORIE RESTRICTION FOR NEUROLOGICAL DISORDERS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Managing volatile neurodegenerative disorders and age-regulated central nervous system (CNS) conditions effectively requires micro-scale formulations that can safely upregulate neuroprotective pathways.
description: A synergistic small-molecule pharmaceutical composition blending Tyrphostin AG 1478 and Kinetin Riboside compounds, formulated to accurately mimic calorie restriction mechanisms and enhance cell survival bounds.
applications: Neurodegenerative disease clinical management (Alzheimer's/Parkinson's), neuro-oncology treatment pathways, age-related cognitive impairment therapies, and targeted neuroprotective supplements.
